concerns.text: The plan fits a GLMM with a Gaussian link for the Utility metric ("Utility → Gaussian link"). Utility is defined per‑episode as a binary success/failure (task_success), so modeling it as a continuous Gaussian outcome violates construct validity and may produce biased estimates. A logistic (or binomial) link should be used for this binary outcome.

The GLMM includes only fixed effects for `method` and `domain` and omits a random intercept for each episode (or a paired‑sample structure). Since the same episodes are evaluated across all three pipelines, failing to model episode‑level correlation inflates Type I error risk and leaves a major confound uncontrolled.
